Name: Reumah
Summary: Reumah was Nahor's concubine and the mother of Tebah, Gaham, Thahash, and Maachah.
KeyStory: Reumah's four sons are listed alongside Milcah's eight, completing the record of Nahor's twelve children.
RelatedPeople: Nahor, Brother of Abraham; Tebah; Gaham; Thahash; Maachah
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
